violations.text: The establishment does not have a written procedure for cleaning vomit and diarrhea. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/24/2026
Handsink was being used as a dump sink. Observed ice in sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. New Violation. Correct By: 11/24/2026

Working containers of (dessert toppings ) are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 11/24/2026

The concentration of the sanitizer solution for the wet wiping cloths was (0 ) parts per million (ppm). The required concentration for (quaternary) sanitizer is (200-400 ) ppm. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/24/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the (quaternary ) sanitizing solution for the (3 bay sink and sani buckets ). New Violation. Correct By: 11/24/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the (grill table and prep table shelves ) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 11/24/2026
The outside refuse area observed with an accumulation of foliage, debris, equipment). Refuse areas must be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 11/24/2026

The floors and walls throughout the kitchen and back storage area have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 11/24/2026

Food contact surfaces of the ice machine were observed with an accumulation of biofilm. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice machine was taken out of service to be cleaned and sanitized. New Violation. Correct By: 04/06/2026

Working containers of ingredients and toppings are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 04/06/2026

Single service items are not being stored properly in their original protective package and/or are stored on a surface that is not clean in the cooking and ice cream areas. New Violation. Correct By: 04/06/2026

Bulk milk dispensing tube was observed several inches long, and cut straight across. The bulk milk container dispensing tube shall be cut on the diagonal leaving no more than one inch protruding from the chilled dispensing head. New Violation. Correct By: 04/06/2026
The grease filter machine was not in good repair, taped, with tape dangling. New Violation. Correct By: 04/06/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the following have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: can opener base grease filter machine walk in shelves microwave shelf prep unit plastic cart soup bowl bins potion cup bins cold drawer unit beneath flattop grills char grill underside of shelf above toaster. The ice cream cabinets, and the plastic ice cream protector inside ice cream chest freezer have an accumulation of frost and/or ice. New Violation. Correct By: 04/06/2026

The dumpster enclosure, and the space between the dumpster enclosure and fence have an accumulation of decomposed vegetation, leaf litter, and debris. Dumpster areas must be maintained clean to prevent harborage of pests. New Violation. Correct By: 04/06/2026
The wall behind the blenders has an accumulation of dried splash food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 04/06/2026
Grease droplets observed along back of hood panel. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 04/06/2026
Mops must be allowed to air dry after use. New Violation. Correct By: 04/06/2026

The pipes/conduits behind the fryer area has an accumulation of grease, soil residue, and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 04/06/2026
